title: Import
description: Where the Markdown files of the latest crawl go: the knowledge collection and the chunk sizes of its documents.

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: The knowledge collection the documents go into (IRI).

chunkTargetSize.title: Chunk target size
chunkTargetSize.description: Characters per chunk. Smaller chunks suit short pages: a price or a contact gets its own chunk.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap
chunkOverlap.description: Characters a chunk repeats from the one before; less than the target size.

chunkMinSize.title: Chunk minimum size
chunkMinSize.description: A shorter rest is merged into the chunk before.

deleteVanished.title: Remove vanished pages
deleteVanished.description: Remove the documents of pages the latest crawl no longer has. Skipped when a page failed.
